summary: Billing master-switch end-to-end verified across backend and frontend. Backend PUT /api/admin/settings <-> GET /api/billing-status round trip works for both true and false, and /billing-status exposes billing_enabled + premium_for_all. Frontend behavior confirmed with u1@test.com: when billing is OFF the Profile dot is GRAY (rgb(107,140,174) = textMuted), a gold PREMIUM badge is shown, the 'Nenda Premium' upgrade button is hidden, and the mini/full player show the RINGTONE prompt ('Weka Wimbo huu muito wa simu yangu') with no Changia / Nenda Premium / subscribe modal. When billing is toggled ON via admin API, focusing the Wasifu tab refreshes state and the Profile dot turns GREEN (rgb(46,213,115) = success), the 'Nenda Premium' upgrade card reappears, and the PREMIUM badge disappears — proving useFocusEffect + AppState refresh works without a reload. Toggle-back to OFF also refreshes correctly on tab focus. Billing left OFF at end (user's current desired state). No bugs found; the previously-reported sync issue is fixed.
action_items: (Optional / low priority) Consider adding testID to tab-bar buttons in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (e.g. tabBarButtonTestID or a custom tabBarButton) — currently tabs must be selected by role name which is brittle for automation.

(Optional) Backend /api/billing-status returns 401s in some browser sessions before login-token attaches (visible as CONSOLE 401 warnings on cold load). Public endpoint call is fine functionally but the client may be sending stale token; verify billingApi.status() does not require Authorization.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/billing.py:37-42 uses correct fallback ordering (settings.billing_enabled -> app_config.billing -> default true). Good single-source-of-truth.
AuthContext.tsx computes effectivePremium = isPremium || !billingEnabled || premiumForAll and refreshes on mount + AppState active — correct.
PlayerContext.tsx stopForFreeHours guards with isPremiumRef (which now mirrors effectivePremium) so billing OFF prevents free-hour stops — correct.
PlayerPromptBanner returns ringtone prompt when effectivePremium or isNew, and never returns contribute when billing is off — correct.
profile.tsx correctly gates upgrade behind !isGuest && !effectivePremium && billingEnabled and calls refreshBilling() inside useFocusEffect — correct.

rca_of_issue: Root cause was previously fixed: /billing-status now reads settings.billing_enabled (same key admin PUTs to). Foreground/focus refresh added in AuthContext (AppState 'active') and profile.tsx (useFocusEffect -> refreshBilling). PlayerContext also refetches billing on AppState 'active' and gates stopForFreeHours behind isPremiumRef which mirrors effectivePremium. All flows verified end-to-end via API round trip and UI observation.
